in_sanskrit.name: Swarna
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'swar' meaning gold, Swarn (Swarna) is a name that evokes images of radiance, prosperity, and good fortune. This name is often given to babies born during the harvest season or to those who are believed to be destined for a life of wealth and success.

in_hindi.long_meaning: Swarn स्वर्ण is a name of Indian origin, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Swarna' meaning gold. It is a unisex name that is commonly used in both Hindu and Jain communities. The name Swarn is associated with prosperity, wealth, and good fortune. It is believed that a child named Swarn will grow up to be radiant, successful, and blessed.
